blocks.text:
Whether you’re fishing, boating, geocaching, or traveling, this compact Watertight Box protects gear, documents, and other valuables from the elements. Wallets stay dry, camera lenses unscratched, and cell phones free from dirt and sand when they’re inside.Made from translucent, shatterproof polycarbonate, the box has an O-ring closure for a watertight seal. Use the rubber tether key-ring style attachment to clip the box to yourself, your boat, or your backpack, and you won’t have to worry about dropping expensive cameras or phones during your adventure. This box is not intended for climbing, load-bearing use, or full submersion. The Watertight Box comes in the following sizes:Small – 840-milliliter capacity; 3.25 x 5.25 x 6.75 inchesLarge – 1.5-liter capacity; 3.5 x 6.8 x 8 inches
 Outdoor Products manufactures quality gear for all facets of an adventurous life – including heavy duty frame camping backpacks, waist packs, travel duffles, watertight bags and cases, and outdoor accessories. Started as a department store for outdoor enthusiasts in 1973, Outdoor Products continues to help you pack for all of your work, play, camping, and travel adventures.

items: Multipurpose box protects against moisture, dust, dirt, and sand; great for boating, kayaking, fishing, and more
Rubber key clip and strap attachment point; O-ring closure for a watertight seal
Made from shatterproof translucent polycarbonate; small size measures 3.25 x 5.25 x 6.75 inches with 840 ml capacity
Not intended for climbing, load-bearing use, or full submersion
Backed by a manufacturers 1-year limited warranty
